items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury suffered/aggravated in Week 3.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated Week 3 vs Raiders; coach Kellen Moore confirmed.
items.implication: Out at least 4 games; next eligibility ~Week 9 after bye.

items.text: Packers placing WR Jayden Reed on IR; will undergo season-ending neck surgery.
items.why: Neck injury; Matt LaFleur confirmed surgery; Reed posted '11 out'.
items.implication: Gone for season; GB WR room reconfigures permanently.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining WRs and TE.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list as top-10 play this week (TNF vs CLE); believes despite short week after big usage.
items.why: Led RBs with 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches prior week; CLE allows big RB yards; Dowdle out.
items.implication: Strong RB1/flex start in workhorse role.
items.opportunity: Near-monopoly on Steelers RB snaps/carries/routes with Dowdle OUT.

items.text: Ravens Thursday injury report: Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers among those upgraded to full.
items.why: Upgraded on official Thursday report after prior limited/back/hamstring.
items.implication: Both expected to play without restriction vs Titans.
items.opportunity: Full snap/route shares restored; Flowers another week removed from hamstring.

items.text: 49ers Mike Evans (ribs) TBD; GM Lynch: old-school mindset, will make every attempt to play, see where it goes. Bosa unlikely (calf).
items.why: Ribs from Week 3; coach/GM comments optimistic on attempt.
items.implication: Game-time or Friday decision; if out benefits other 49ers pass-catchers.

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay expects WR Puka Nacua (groin/hip) to play Sunday vs Eagles.
items.why: Progress in recovery; limited practice then coach confirmation.
items.implication: Likely active; monitor snaps if limited.
items.opportunity: Full WR1 role returns if unrestricted.

items.text: No practice for WR Justin Jefferson (ankle); team considers him day-to-day.
items.why: Ankle; limited routes (2) before exiting prior game.
items.implication: Monitor Friday/Saturday; could play vs Dolphins.

items.text: Jaylen Warren full workhorse Week 3: 90% snaps, 17/19 RB carries, 26 routes/37 dropbacks, 4 targets (11.8% share).
items.implication: Elite volume heading into short week.
items.opportunity: Dominates carries, routes, snaps; goal-line/third-down likely.

items.text: De'Von Achane officially out for season (torn ACL Week 3 vs Chiefs).
Breece Hall on shelf foreseeable future (quad); elevates Braelon Allen to prominent/workhorse role.
items.implication: Allen top waiver; 100% RB snaps post-exit prior.

items.text: Drake London LOVE: 35%+ career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in return; NO allows WR TDs.
items.why: Penix back; alpha WR1 usage returns after slow start.

items.text: Justin Herbert HATE @ SEA: 44% pressure rate; SEA 4th pressure, league-low YPA/YPC; Chargers bottom-3 implied total.
Kyle Pitts HATE: low target share (career 16% with Penix), TE37 utilization; quiet even in Penix return (low snaps/routes).
items.why: Blocking specialists preferred in 12-pers; low aDOT/targets inside 10.

items.text: Justin Jefferson ankle does not sound serious; only 2 routes before injury (2-32-0) in Kyler first full game (concerning for Murray).
items.why: Injury severity low per early info; volume truncated.
